description: Check a batch of images against a delivery spec before sending it: formats, file size, exact/min/max width and height, shape (aspect ratio), transparency, colour space, DPI, embedded metadata and file naming. Start from a preset ("web": Website images, "instagram": Instagram feed, "marketplace": Marketplace product photos, "appicon": App Store icon, "print": Print handover (large JPEG/PNG)) or "custom", and override any rule. Reports pass / needs attention / fail per file and which tool fixes each problem. Changes nothing. [Pro tool.]

colour_space.description: "srgb": flag CMYK, wide-gamut (Display P3, Adobe RGB) and other profiles.

files.description: Images (and SVGs) or folders. ~ is your home folder.

max_kb.description: Largest file size in KB (0 = any).

max_name.description: Longest file name in characters (0 = any).

metadata.description: "none": flag files that still carry EXIF, GPS location, XMP or IPTC.

min_dpi.description: Minimum DPI written in the file (0 = any). DPI is only a label; pixel size is what really counts for print.

name_pattern.description: A regular expression every file name must match, e.g. "^sku-\d{4}-(front|back)\.jpg$".

no_spaces.description: Names without spaces or special characters.

preset.description: Starting rules. web: JPEG/PNG/WebP/SVG/AVIF under 500 KB, at most 2560 px, lowercase names without spaces. instagram: JPEG/PNG, at least 1080 wide, 1:1, 4:5, 3:4 or 1.91:1, under 8 MB. marketplace: JPEG/PNG, at least 1600×1600, square, no transparency, under 10 MB. appicon: PNG exactly 1024×1024, no transparency. print: JPEG/PNG at least 3000×2000, tidy names. custom: only the rules you give.

ratio_tolerance.description: How far off a shape may be, in percent (the site allows 1%).

ratios.description: Allowed shapes, like ["1:1", "4:5", "16:9"]. Empty list = any shape.

transparency.description: Transparent areas: any, required (e.g. logos) or forbidden (e.g. app icons, marketplace photos).

name: check_delivery
title: Check images against a delivery spec
